verdict.rationale: A Google-owned repository (googleapis/mcp-toolbox) is documented as an open-source MCP server for databases, and the probe flags it as BigQuery's official MCP server, so an agent can plausibly connect through a first-party MCP server. The evidence never explicitly states that this toolbox supports BigQuery or documents its tools or setup. It is also a generic database toolbox rather than a BigQuery-specific or hosted endpoint. missing for 10: explicit confirmation of BigQuery support in the MCP server, documented BigQuery tools and agent connection/auth setup, independent or hands-on corroboration.
